title: Prophecies of Joseph Smith

footnotes.text: Some of Joseph Smith’s contemporaries left later, reminiscent accounts purporting to contain specific prophecies by Joseph Smith, but it is difficult to substantiate whether these statements were authentic.
Historical Introduction to Joseph Smith, Journal, 1839,josephsmithpapers.org. They returned to Nauvoo for a few months before finally embarking on their mission.

Joseph Smith, “History, 1838–1856, volume D-1 [1 August 1842–1 July 1843],” 1464,josephsmithpapers.org; punctuation standardized. In some instances, Joseph Smith used prophetic language in informal settings. See, for example, “History of Joseph Smith,”Latter-Day Saints’ Millennial Star,vol. 22, no. 29 (July 1, 1860), 455.
